title: Fast-fashion giant Shein's shares drop 9% in Hong Kong market debut
summary: Shein made its Hong Kong market debut on Tuesday after years of attempts to go public, though shares declined 9% in the opening session. The listing represents a significant milestone for the fast-fashion e-commerce company, though initial market skepticism is evident.
content: Shein made its Hong Kong market debut on Tuesday after years of attempts to go public.

zh.title: 快时尚巨头Shein在香港市场首次亮相股价下跌9%
zh.summary: 经过多年上市尝试，Shein周二在香港市场首次亮相，尽管开盘交易中股价下跌9%。该上市代表了这家快时尚电商公司的一个重要里程碑，但初期市场怀疑态度明显。

title: Bessent reportedly tells Russia no economic relief until Ukraine war ends as Europe snubs Moscow at G20
summary: U.S. Treasury Secretary Bessent signaled that economic relief for Russia is contingent on ending the Ukraine war, reflecting Washington's willingness to engage in diplomacy. The statement at the G20 meeting underscored a division between U.S. openness and European insistence on continued isolation.
content: The meeting underscored Washington's willingness to reopen diplomatic talks with Moscow, as Europe intends to isolate the nation while the war continues.

zh.title: 据报道贝森特告诉俄罗斯在乌克兰战争结束前不会获得经济救济，欧洲在G20会议上冷落莫斯科
zh.summary: 美国财政部长贝森特暗示经济救济俄罗斯取决于乌克兰战争的结束，反映了华盛顿从事外交的意愿。G20会议上的声明突显了美国开放态度与欧洲坚持继续孤立的分歧。

title: Shein shares slide in long-awaited stock market debut
summary: Shein's Hong Kong listing marks the culmination of a years-long effort to go public after failed attempts in New York and London. The stock's initial decline reflects market concerns about the company's valuation and business model.
content: The firm's Hong Kong listing on Tuesday comes after a years-long quest to sell shares in New York and London.

zh.title: Shein在期待已久的股市首次公开募股中股价下滑
zh.summary: Shein的香港上市标志着经过多年努力在纽约和伦敦失败后实现上市。股票初期下跌反映了市场对该公司估值和商业模式的担忧。

title: Tanker struck in Hormuz, raising worries over escalation, as Trump vows to hit Iran 'hard'
summary: A tanker was struck in the Strait of Hormuz following Iran's attack on two American bases in Jordan, escalating regional tensions. The incident raises concerns about broader conflict expansion and threats to global energy security.
content: Iran launched an attack on two American bases in Jordan on Monday in retaliation for the U.S. attack on its Larak Island.

zh.title: 霍尔木兹海峡油轮遭袭，引发升级担忧，特朗普誓言对伊朗"狠狠打击"
zh.summary: 一艘油轮在霍尔木兹海峡遭袭，发生在伊朗对约旦两个美军基地的攻击之后，导致地区局势升级。该事件引发了对冲突扩大的担忧，以及对全球能源安全的威胁。

title: Venezuela grants U.S.-backed oil firm NABEP 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says
summary: Venezuelan interim authorities granted North American Blue Energy Partners 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, marking a significant shift toward U.S. influence in the country's energy sector. The deal represents a major geopolitical realignment in Latin American oil operations.
content: Venezuelan interim authorities have granted North American Blue Energy Partners 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says.

zh.title: 委内瑞拉向美国支持的石油公司NABEP授予17个油田100年特许权，白宫表示
zh.summary: 委内瑞拉临时当局向北美蓝能源合伙公司授予17个油田的100年特许权，标志着该国能源部门向美国影响力的重大转变。该协议代表了拉丁美洲石油业务的重大地缘政治格局调整。

title: Indian PM Modi implores Putin to end Ukraine war amid U.S. tariff threat on Russian oil
summary: An unusual divide in the options market is creating opportunities for investors to generate higher income from individual stocks, according to Janus Henderson. This market anomaly suggests potential for sophisticated investors to capitalize on pricing inefficiencies.
content: Indian PM Narendra Modi has urged Russia to end the Ukraine war and to cease hostilities.

zh.title: 印度总理莫迪恳求普京结束乌克兰战争，美国对俄罗斯石油关税威胁加重
zh.summary: 根据詹姆斯·亨德森的说法，期权市场中不寻常的分歧为投资者创造了从个股中获得更高收入的机会。这种市场异常表明精明投资者有可能利用定价低效现象。

title: ‘Unusual gap’ in stock options presents investors with big opportunity, Janus Henderson says
summary: Oil trading is becoming more accessible to individual investors through smaller futures contracts, ETFs, and online brokerages, lowering traditional barriers to entry. This democratization of the $3 trillion market could fundamentally shift the landscape of commodity trading.
content: An unusual divide in the options market is creating an opportunity for investors to generate higher income from individual stocks, according to Janus Henderson.

zh.title: 詹姆士·亨德森：股票期权中的"异常差距"为投资者带来大机遇
zh.summary: 通过较小的期货合约、ETF和在线经纪商，石油交易对散户投资者变得越来越容易进入，降低了传统的进入障碍。这个3万亿美元市场的民主化可能会从根本上改变商品交易的格局。

title: The $3 trillion oil market has just gotten more accessible than ever: No longer a 'rich man's game'
summary: North American Blue Energy Partners will assume control of Venezuelan oilfields previously operated by Chinese and Russian companies. This transition reflects a significant geopolitical realignment in Venezuela's energy sector away from Eastern influence.
content: Oil trading is becoming more accessible to individual investors as smaller futures contracts, ETFs and online brokerages lower longtime barriers to the market.

zh.title: 3万亿美元石油市场的可进入性创新高：不再是"富人游戏"
zh.summary: 北美蓝能源伙伴公司将接管之前由中国和俄罗斯公司运营的委内瑞拉油田。这一过渡反映了委内瑞拉能源部门远离东方影响的重大地缘政治重新调整。
